summary: ODAYA RailKit integration end-to-end testing complete. Backend 10/10 pytest tests pass against public URL: /api/health returns groq_configured:true AND railkit_ready:true; /api/railkit/stations/search?name=delhi returns real station list; /api/railkit/stations/NDLS returns NDLS metadata; /api/railkit/trains/between/NDLS/BCT returns real train list with train_no/train_name fields; /api/railkit/trains/12951/info returns trainInfo + non-empty route; /api/railkit/trains/12951/live returns valid shape with success flag; /api/railkit/trains/12951/history?date=<yday> returns valid shape; /api/railkit/seats/12951/MMCT/NDLS/15-11-2026/3A/GN returns valid shape; /api/railkit/pnr/0000000000 gracefully returns {success:false,error:...} with HTTP 400 (no crash); /api/chat still returns Groq replies. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home shows 'Powered by RailKit' strip, 6 tiles, Assistant FAB. Train Search live station picker returns 10 options for 'new delhi' (NDLS present) and 2 for 'mumbai central' (MMCT, BCL); NDLS->MMCT renders 33 real train cards; tapping a card opens Train Detail with real info (34 stops, 1880 km, 29:00 hrs for 12904 Golden Temple M). Tapping 'See all stops' navigates to Train Route screen with 34 real stops & arr/dep/halt/day/distance. Live Status with 12951 shows real statusNote 'Departed from ANKLESHWAR JN(AKV) at 20:57 01-Oct', CURRENTLY AT ANKLESHWAR JN, progress 312/1380 km 23%, 88.8 km/h, real stoppages list; 7-DAY HISTORY tab renders all 7 past days (30-24 SEP) each resolving to COMPLETED MMCT->NDLS DONE. Seat Availability with 12951 MMCT->NDLS 3A/GN returns real fare breakdown (Base 1820, Reserv 40, SF 45, Total 3165) and 4 availability rows (WL 12/26/52, RAC 78) with AVL/RAC/WL tags. Invalid PNR 0000000000 shows graceful 'No PNR data found or invalid PNR number' banner (no red screen). No critical/blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _railkit_get maps upstream success:false to HTTP 400 which is sensible; however when the Node service is down httpx raises HTTPError -> 502 'Railway service unavailable' which is good. Consider adding a timeout-specific message when RailKit SDK is slow (>25s).

server.py: no caching on station_search / station_by_code - if the frontend debounces per keystroke and the user types fast, each keystroke causes an upstream RailKit call. Consider in-memory TTL cache (e.g. 10min) for /stations/search and /stations/{code} to reduce RailKit rate-limit pressure.

railkit microservice (server.mjs): /trains/:number/live defaults date to 'today' server-side (good). But /trains/:number/history requires date in DD-MM-YYYY with no validation -> an invalid format will bubble up as SDK error with 500 instead of 400. Low priority.
Frontend: StationPicker debounces at 350ms which is appropriate; good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6 flows: Home, Train Search, Train Detail, Train Route, Live+History, Seat Avail, PNR invalid)

seed_data_creation: None. All data pulled live from RailKit. Chat test added one TEST entry to chat_logs (safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://odaya-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend proxies 9 RailKit endpoints under /api/railkit/*; actual SDK runs as Node microservice on 127.0.0.1:7001 (supervisor program 'railkit'). RailKit may rate-limit on repeat calls (<=1 call per endpoint during tests). Date format for live/history is DD-MM-YYYY and 'today' resolves server-side. Station picker needs typed string >=2 chars; options show as data-testid="<picker-testid>-option-<CODE>". When searching 'mumbai central' the station code is MMCT (not BCT) in RailKit's catalog - prefer MMCT for Mumbai Central. Live Status testIDs: live-train-input, live-track-button, tab-live, tab-history, history-list, history-day-<idx>. Train Detail -> 'See all 34 stops' button is detail-see-full-route. Seat Avail testIDs: avail-train-input, avail-from-input, avail-to-input, avail-class-chip-<SL|3A|2A|1A|CC>, avail-fetch-button, avail-row-<idx>. All backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_railkit_api.py pass in ~3s because Node service caches via SDK on single run.
